title: Family-owned, customer-first.
description: At MG Appliance, we believe buying an appliance shouldn't be stressful. We're a family-owned retailer built on honest pricing, a huge selection, and treating every customer like a neighbor. Need a new fridge, stove, washer, or dryer? We'll help you find the right fit. Appliance acting up? Our repair team can get it running again. Sales and service — all under one roof.
